headline: Search volume up a third, lead value soft: NP back to an average Wednesday
commentary:
### The day
- NP $4,306 at 14.2% margin — the Monday-Tuesday run had to end somewhere.
  - NP: $4,306 v $11,910 Tuesday
  - Last Wed: $1,766
- Against other Wednesdays this is dead average, and we spent less doing it.
  - 8-week Wednesday NP mean: $4,769
  - Cost: $25,996 v $41,574 mean
- **November still well ahead of October** on the same days, on the same money.
  - MTD NP: $30,993 v $20,432
  - MTD NM: 21.5% v 15.2%
### What drove it
- Search carried it: a third more clicks at last week's price.
  - Search cost: $19,680 v $14,517 last Wed
  - Search NP: $2,370 v −$363
- Lead value was the drag, below the month's pace across the board.
  - Search EPL: $21.47 v $24.25 MTD
  - API EPL: $17.98 v $20.10 last 7
- **Our biggest tree priced soft**; Direct Lenders picked up some of it.
  - Direct (Inc ZP) EPL: $17.01 v $21.01 last 7
  - Direct Lenders EPL: $25.91 v $19.04
- Bing pushed $4,557 out and handed back four dollars.
  - Bing NP: $4 v −$108 last Wed
  - Bing EPL: $12.13 v $10.63
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 04/11 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Off seasonality adjustments | competitor, tROAS only | $463 | $265 | — |
| Speed walk-down | high tROAS, stepped down | $615 | $154 | — |
| Scavenger pair | tROAS plus tCPA copy | $1,057 | $936 | — |
- Speed is deliberately priced high and coming down in steps, so volume stays thin.
  - Speed cost: $615 v $154 last Wed
  - Speed CPC: $14.64 v $19.22
- The scavengers hunt cheap clicks and sit off at weekends; spend ticking up slowly.
  - Combined scavenger spend: $1,057 v $936
  - Scavenger CPCs: $3.32 and $3.81
watch: Whether the Direct (Inc ZP) tree at $17.01 is one soft day or a genuine repricing against the $21.01 seven-day average.
Brand defence: our cle_brand impression share fell to 27.1% from 43.4% with uprova, netcredit and lendingtree all bidding harder on our name.
Search CPC, running $10.84 MTD against $11.89 last month, while uprova added 9 points of account-level impression share.
